entries.name: Buttons and inspection
entries.notes: Appearance roles resolved by ControlAppearance.js with contract precedence; the nine size presets are still pending a consuming workspace.

entries.name: Primary / confirmation button
entries.notes: Primary role: green when ready, stronger when highlighted; destructive never green; End Turn uses the registered combatEndTurn exception.

entries.name: Back / cancel button
entries.notes: Back/Close/Cancel/Leave carry the exit role: brown/gold at rest, red while highlighted; a sole exit in the primary slot is not green.

entries.name: Exit button
entries.notes: Header exit carries the exit role; its face turns red under pointer, keyboard, or pad highlight. Square geometry from --iconbtn-size.

entries.name: Ordered active stack
entries.notes: Ordered active stack from CombatantStackModel: HP, resources, buildup by fill, stance, icons; max five rows; excess buildup becomes ring pips.

entries.name: Inspector facts
entries.notes: Inspector facts render as uniform label/value rows from CombatantInspectorSections; empty states say None. or Unknown.

entries.name: Meters and statuses
entries.notes: Branch feature/wireframe-meters: CombatantMeterModel.js owns row heights and selected-only visibility from wireframeUi.combatantMeters; the combat layout adapter writes them as CSS variables.

entries.name: Health meter
entries.notes: HP at least max(0.85rem, 14 physical px); compact current/maximum at 12 physical px; full accessible label kept.

entries.name: Resource meter
entries.notes: Half the HP height, at least 0.45rem; exact values in the tooltip and inspector (the row is too short for readable text). Selected-only by default.

entries.name: Buildup meter
entries.notes: Buildup rows share the secondary height; glyph nub kept. Selected-only by default.

entries.name: Stance strip
entries.notes: The stance chip renders as a strip the size of HP in formation, after the buildup rows. Selected-only by default.

entries.name: Status icon
entries.notes: Status icons use the configured 1.575rem tile (reference rem at least 16 physical px); one non-wrapping row.

entries.name: Icon overflow
entries.notes: Overflow collapses to a final +N tile that opens the combatant inspector with every effect; co-op keeps its popover.

entries.name: Draw pile button

entries.notes: Already implemented: HUD_REFERENCE_MAX 200/20/20, track = max/reference, fill = current/max, no minimum track length, scaleByMax on the main HUD.

entries.name: Map composition
entries.notes: Atlas (src/ui/screens/worldAtlas.js) composes header, map scene, context band and Recenter/Enter footer. No region selector: a journey has one world map.

entries.name: Map viewport
entries.notes: Atlas scene: the scrollport is the camera and fills the scene band (~63% of height).

entries.name: Node button
entries.notes: Atlas node buttons select a discovered place (aria-pressed ring); tapping the selected place again enters it.

entries.name: Node details
entries.notes: Classic map context band: floor, kind, blurb, boss destination, key reveal; shown kind under fog; sizes to content up to 20%. Atlas context band: region, name, road state and description of the selected place, open roads, sealed roads, guiding lights; capped at 20% and scrolls inside.

entries.name: Region selector
entries.notes: Not applicable to the atlas: a journey has one world map.

entries.name: Recenter button
entries.notes: Classic map footer Recenter calls the board resetFraming. Atlas footer Recenter is the former "You" camera control.

entries.name: Enter node button
entries.notes: Classic map footer Enter is disabled until a reachable node is selected, then names the kind; picking the selected node again also enters. Atlas footer Enter travels a selected open road via onTravel, or opens the place where you stand; disabled for a place with no road.
